allocation_rules: Do not add child attempts, setup commands or subphase seconds to their inclusive parent interval.
Common case preparation is charged in full to each single-use workflow for comparison; show half allocation separately only as shared-study sensitivity. Neither allocation is complete economic cost.
Boundary qualification is shared study setup; retain it once in study accounting and disclose any claimed amortization. No invented reuse count or zero-cost allocation.
Native replay and treatment replay have different additional exposed-case counts; their isolated driver clocks are not like-for-like quality or cost ratios.
Publication and final repository integration are additional study delivery work; the final outer window will include them.
Cached tokens are already included in input totals. Do not infer provider dollars from these counts.
Evaluation contains both arms and common oracle work. Keep its inclusive study clock separate; no claim that all of it is an ordinary single-arm product cost.
